name: Randon
description: Randon was a planet located in the Randon system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories, at the confluence of a number of hyperspace routes. The Ootmian Pabol ran through Randon, and three routes began at the world: the Trax Tube, the Pabol Sleheyron and the Randon Run.
lead_paragraphs: Randon was a planet located in the Randon system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories, at the confluence of a number of hyperspace routes. The Ootmian Pabol ran through Randon, and three routes began at the world: the Trax Tube, the Pabol Sleheyron and the Randon Run.
In 33 BBY, the Idiot Three were dropped off on Randon by Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi after attempting to hijack the Regal Zephyr.
